text: Coffee with Rafael and Irina. They've finally had an offer accepted on the flat in Leith and get the keys 14 November. Irina's already ordering paint samples. Must offer to help them move the weekend after. Rafael's also started a pottery class on Wednesdays and keeps sending me photos of lopsided mugs. Their friend Hugo is driving the van, apparently.
Hugo is obsessed with bouldering now, goes three nights a week. His girlfriend Divya thinks it's a phase. He's entering his first comp on 3rd of December and is quietly bricking it.

Long catch-up with Kiri. Her manager Andre is leaving at the end of the month and she's been asked to cover his role. She's flattered but exhausted. Leaving drinks are 28/11, I said I'd come. Andre's moving to a rival agency, and Kiri reckons half the clients will follow him. Her husband Luis keeps telling her to ask for a pay rise before she says yes.
Karan's moving to Glasgow for the new job. Viewing three flats on Saturday, signs whatever he likes the day before he starts on 6 Jan. Text him that evening to see how the viewings went.
Freya knits constantly now, mostly socks. Wants a proper yarn swift, kept mentioning it. Her birthday's 9th of March.
Oisín was on about the Leinster game, he's got tickets for 22 November with his brother Cian. Then off to Lisbon the next day for a week. Lucky sod.

Grabbed lunch with Rin. Client from hell at work, a guy called Mr Walsh who rewrites every brief. Her review is on the 2nd and she's worried he'll torpedo it. Remind me to check in with her afterwards. On the plus side she's joined a book club, they're doing Middlemarch, and she's the only one who finished it. Her colleague Tamar Ito is covering the Walsh account while she's off on the 9th.
Salma and Aneesh have called off the house move, the chain collapsed. They're staying put for now and redoing the kitchen instead. Salma sounded relieved honestly.
Imogen's dad has his hip op on 17 November. She's driving up the morning of and staying the week. Send her a message that evening.
Magda plays in a darts league on Thursdays. Team's called the Flying Dutchmen even though none of them are Dutch. She's vegetarian, keeps forgetting.

Quick chat with Blessing at the school gate. She's started a pottery course, loves it, has made about nine wonky bowls. Her son Tunde starts secondary in September and she's already stressing about it.
Need to book the van for the 30th. Boxes from the Co-op, tape, bubble wrap. Ring the letting agent about the deposit the day after.

Marta and Krisztina are doing the Budapest half marathon on 12 October next year. Training starts in spring apparently. Krisztina's the serious one, Marta is in it for the medal. Krisztina's husband Kemal has offered to drive them to the airport and then sulk in a café for the weekend. They're flying out on 10 October and back the day after the race.

Spent ages on the phone with Vanessa. Her landlord's selling so she's got to be out by 31/01. She's viewing places in Bristol and Bath, leaning Bath because of her sister Eva. She's properly anxious about it, hasn't slept well in weeks. Her cat Biscuit hates moving too, which doesn't help. I should send her the link to that flat on Walcot Street and offer to come to a viewing with her. Her birthday is 4th of February so maybe a housewarming-ish gift once she's settled.
Hemi supports the All Blacks with frankly alarming passion. Watching the test on Saturday at Lorenzo's. Bring beers.
Lorenzo got promoted to team lead! Starts the new role 1st of December. His boss Cem apparently fought for it. Must send congrats.
Eva mentioned her brother Felix is getting married 15 August in Cornwall. She's doing a reading and is nervous about it. Hen do the weekend before.
Svetlana collects vintage Penguin paperbacks, orange spines only. She's after an early copy of Brideshead. Could be a good one for Christmas.
Luis and his husband Tunde are moving to Manchester in the new year. Luis is transferring offices, Tunde is still job hunting. Leaving party at theirs on the 13th. Don't forget to get them a card.
Abebe has a big pitch to a client on Thursday, the 6th. He's rehearsed it to death. Text him good luck that morning and ask how it went the next day.
Bridget's mum died last week. Funeral is 3 November in Cork. Bridget's flying over the day before with her husband. Should send flowers to the house.

Tamar is learning Japanese for a trip to Kyoto in April. Uses an app every morning, already on a 200 day streak. Her partner Kemal refuses to learn anything beyond konnichiwa. They fly out 3rd of April and stay a fortnight. Tamar's also planning to visit her old flatmate Rin in Osaka the week after they land. Ask her for the ramen place list when she's back.
Kemal mentioned his manager is a nightmare, micromanages everything. He's had two interviews elsewhere, final round on 19th Nov. Wish him luck the day before.
Rafael (Raf) asked if I'd help him move a sofa on Sunday. Said yes. He's moving into Irina's place properly now.
Irina's brother Hugo got into the Royal College of Music! Starts next September. She was beaming. Ask Hugo how the scholarship interview went, that's on 10/12.
Divya plays chess online for hours. Rated about 1800. Doesn't like losing to me, which is fine because she never does.
Kiri's dog Rolo had surgery on his leg on Monday. She's taking him back for the check on 5 Nov. Ring her the day after to see how he is.
Andre's retiring at Christmas after 31 years. Party on 19th of December at the Crown. Collection going round for a gift, I need to chip in by Friday.

Drinks with Karan, Freya and Oisín. Karan is mid-house-hunt in Glasgow, saw a lovely tenement flat in Partick but someone outbid him. Freya's just back from Edinburgh where she went to the knitting show, bought far too much wool. Oisín's band has a gig on 29 November at Whelan's and he wants us all there. He said he's nervous because it's their first one with the new drummer. Karan is coming down that weekend anyway so we'll make a night of it.
Rin's partner Hemi is starting a PhD in marine biology in February. They'll have to move to Plymouth for it. Rin's not thrilled about leaving London.
Salma's daughter has her driving test on 2nd of December. Third attempt. Salma is more nervous than she is.
Note to self: my flat viewing is 11 Nov at 6pm. Second viewing on the 14th if I like it. Bring payslips.
Aneesh from finance is leaving for a startup. Last day 21/11. Imogen is organising the leaving lunch and asked me to sort the card. Get everyone to sign it the week before.
Imogen does roller derby! Skate name is Imogen Disaster. Bouts are monthly, next one on 16 November. Never would have guessed.

Talked to Magda about her new job at the gallery. Starts 3rd of November, part time. Her husband Andre is doing the school runs now. She's excited but a bit terrified. Their eldest is doing her GCSE mocks the same week, so the house is chaos. Andre has taken up sourdough to cope, which is not helping the kitchen situation.
Blessing's sister Marta just had a baby girl, born on the 8th. Called her Ada. Blessing's flying out to Lagos on 2 December to meet her.
Krisztina had a falling out with her boss, Mrs Rossi, over the Banerjee account. Thinks she might quit. She's applying for a role in Leeds, closing date 30 Oct.
Vanessa's moving date got pushed back to 28 Feb. The buyer's mortgage fell through. Irritating but she's got more time to pack. Remember to ask how the new survey goes.
Hemi and Lorenzo are both mad on Warhammer. Hemi's painting a whole army for a tournament in Nottingham, 7th of March. Lorenzo is going along to watch and heckle.
Eva mentioned she's gluten free now, coeliac diagnosis in the summer. Felix is cooking for her birthday on 26 October and he's terrified of getting it wrong.
Bumped into Cem on the train. He supports Galatasaray, watched the derby on Sunday and was hoarse from shouting. His wife Svetlana is pregnant, due in March! I should congratulate her when I see her.
Svetlana's struggling with the morning sickness. Off work this week. Drop round some ginger biscuits on Friday.
Felix and his fiancée Marta went to see three houses in Didsbury today. Loved the second one. Putting in an offer tomorrow, hear back by the end of the week.
Luis says the new office is miles better than the old one. Client lunches every Friday. Boss is called Luis too which causes chaos.
Tunde's starting at the new firm on 4 November. First week is all induction. Ask him how the first day went.

Long video call with Abebe and his wife Bridget. They've finally decided to leave London and are looking at places in Sheffield. Abebe can work remotely three days a week and Bridget wants a garden for her veg. They've got viewings booked on 9 and 10 November and they're staying with her parents the night before. Their son starts reception next September so they want to be settled by summer. Bridget is anxious about the schools. I should send them that Sheffield schools article and ask how the viewings went afterwards.
Tamar plays the cello in an amateur orchestra. Concert on 24th of November, St John's church. She's got a solo. Buy tickets this week.
Kemal's mum is in hospital again, chest infection. He's visiting every evening after work. He looked shattered.
Need to cancel the gym before the move. Also redirect post from 1 December and sort council tax.
Rafael's leaving do was cancelled, the whole team is off sick. Rescheduled for 5th of December instead. He starts at Deloitte on the 8th.
Irina showed me her tattoo designs. She's booked in for her first one on 20/11, a fern on her forearm. She's done a lot of research on the artist.
Hugo said his flatmate Karan Banerjee is moving out at Christmas. Hugo's looking for someone to take the room, £650 a month, Hackney. Ask around.
Freya's grandad turns 90 on 1st of December. Big family party the Saturday after. She's making him a patchwork quilt and is way behind.
Oisín went to the Lisbon conference last week. Said his talk went well. Follow up about the job offer he mentioned there.
Rin and Hemi have split up. She's moving back in with her mum for a bit. Text her this weekend to see how she's doing.
Grocery run, then the tip with the old bookcase. Meter reading before the 30th.

Andre plays five-a-side on Tuesdays and supports Spurs, which explains a lot. His partner Kiri says he's insufferable during derbies. His 40th is on 12 January, she's planning a surprise. Spurs shirt with his name on it would go down well.
Divya's sister Salma has a job interview at the BBC on 13 Nov. Divya's helping her prep. Salma's apparently very calm about it.

Drinks after work with Aneesh and Imogen. Aneesh moved into his new place in Walthamstow at the weekend, still sleeping on a mattress on the floor. Imogen's been made redundant, consultation ended 15/10. She's putting a brave face on but she's worried about money. Remind me to send Imogen that contract role at my place, and ask Aneesh when the housewarming is.
Blessing Usman is my new manager from Monday. Seems sound. Chelsea fan though. Her old team said she's fair but very direct.
